what: no-fallback (AGENTS.md rule 3): crates/blaze-vfs/src/image.rs `open_disks` returns `Result<Disks, String>` and `ImageUse::{Used,Resumed}.disks: Option<String>`, so the daemon cannot tell a disks section of another schema (a rule: the watchers scan) from a corrupt or out-of-file one (an error: the start should stop). Please make it a typed enum, e.g. `DisksUnused { Refused(Refused), Corrupt(Corrupt), Outside, Malformed(&static str) }`, with Display; blaze-cargo serve/daemon.rs `vfs_used` then puts Refused in `Started.disks` and returns a `VfsFault` for the rest (no-fallback-link-cargo does that side).
